help_text:
BOT FILE MANAGER & ARCHIVE GUIDE
Use the following commands to manage storage:

• cd - View bot folder / filemanager
• cd ~ or cd / - Go straight to Root Storage (/storage/emulated/0)
• cd <path> - Browse a specific folder
• cd .. or back - Go back to previous folder
• catfile <file> - Read text file content
• mkdir <folder> - Create a new folder
• download <URL> [name] - Download a file
• upload <file> - Send file to chat
• deletefile <file> - Delete file/folder
• renamefile <old> <new> - Rename file/folder
• movefile <src> <dest> - Move file/folder
• copyfile <src> <dest> - Copy file/folder

📦 ARCHIVE COMMANDS (ZIP / TAR):
• zip <target> [output.zip] - Compress file/folder to ZIP
• unzip <file.zip> [dest_folder] - Extract ZIP file
• tar <target> [output.tar.gz] - Compress file to TAR.GZ
• untar <file.tar.gz> [dest_folder] - Extract TAR/TAR.GZ file
